name: Tipi Camp Oberammergau
beschreibung: The Tipi Camp Oberammergau is located in a valley in the Tiroler Alpen and is surrounded by mountains. The atmosphere of the camp is characterized by a natural setting with meadows and adjacent forests. In the immediate vicinity there are several hiking trails leading to summits and alpine pastures, as well as ski areas that can be reached in winter. The facilities consist of traditional tipi tents, sanitary facilities, and a shared fire pit. Guests can spend a simple camping vacation here with opportunities for hiking, skiing, and nature observation. The location also offers a good starting point for excursions to surrounding villages.
